Name: Ahimaaz, Son of Zadok
Summary: Ahimaaz, son of Zadok, ran messages for David during Absalom's revolt, hiding with Jonathan son of Abiathar at En-rogel, and later outran the Cushite to bring David news of Absalom's death.
KeyStory: Ahimaaz outran every messenger to bring David the news he dreaded.
KeyVerses: 2 Samuel 15:27; 2 Samuel 17:17; 2 Samuel 18:19; 2 Samuel 18:23; 1 Chronicles 6:8; 1 Chronicles 6:53
RelatedPeople: Zadok, Son of Ahitub; Jonathan, Son of Abiathar; King David
LifeLesson: The fastest runner still has to deliver hard news.
